name: One Fine Evening
source:
This is a free fan game to celebrate the new ACNH release! Spending the evening with one of the twin doggos!

[From [url=https://deanwolfwood.itch.io/one-fine-evening]Itch.io[/url]]

Fan-game based on [url=https://www.animal-crossing.com/new-horizons/]Animal Crossing: New Horizons[/url].
translation:
这是一款为庆祝《集合啦！动物森友会》发售而制作的免费同人游戏！与双胞胎狗狗中的一位共度一个夜晚吧！

[摘自[url=https://deanwolfwood.itch.io/one-fine-evening]Itch.io[/url]]

基于[url=https://www.animal-crossing.com/new-horizons/]《集合啦！动物森友会》[/url]制作的同人游戏。
